item.title: Targeting Beta Catenin Degradation in B Cell Leukaemia
item.description: New findings reveal that B cell acute lymphoblastic leukaemia depends on intact beta catenin degradation, highlighting glycogen synthase kinase 3 beta inhibition as a potential therapeutic strategy. The post Targeting Beta Catenin Degradation in B Cell Leukaemia appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Interactive Virtual Assistant Improves Diabetes Outcomes
item.description: A smart speaker acting as an interactive virtual assistant shows promise for improving mental health and glycaemic control in older people with diabetes. The post Interactive Virtual Assistant Improves Diabetes Outcomes appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Unexplained Pauses In CDC Surveillance Databases
item.description: Unexplained pauses in CDC surveillance databases may weaken evidence, clinicians and policymakers utilize for frontline judgements. The post Unexplained Pauses In CDC Surveillance Databases appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Higher Kidney Stone Risk Seen After Malabsorptive Bariatric Surgery
item.description: Malabsorptive bariatric surgery shows higher kidney stone risk than restrictive procedures, based on post-operative 24-hour urine chemistry findings. The post Higher Kidney Stone Risk Seen After Malabsorptive Bariatric Surgery appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Heavy Alcohol Intake Linked to Increased Colorectal Cancer Risk
item.description: Current drinkers with an average lifetime alcohol intake of 14 or more drinks per week had a 25% higher risk of colorectal cancer. The post Heavy Alcohol Intake Linked to Increased Colorectal Cancer Risk appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Dietary Melatonin May Lower Obesity and Depression Risk
item.description: Study of 8,320 adults finds higher dietary melatonin linked to lower obesity and depression risk, with no clear effects on other chronic conditions. The post Dietary Melatonin May Lower Obesity and Depression Risk appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Nomogram Predicts Thyroid Dysfunction Risk in Diabetes
item.description: Using univariate and multivariate logistic regression, the investigators identified eight independent predictors of thyroid dysfunction. The post Nomogram Predicts Thyroid Dysfunction Risk in Diabetes appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: SGLT2 Inhibitors Linked to Improved Kidney Outcomes in Type 2 Diabetes
item.description: A nationwide comparative study shows SGLT2 inhibitors lower long-term chronic kidney disease and acute kidney injury risk compared with GLP-1 receptor agonists. The post SGLT2 Inhibitors Linked to Improved Kidney Outcomes in Type 2 Diabetes appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Nomogram Predicts Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Cryoballoon Ablation
item.description: When benchmarked against widely used risk scores, including APPLE, SUCCESS, PAT2C2H, HATCH, BASE-AF2, and CHA₂DS₂-VASc, the nomogram consistently demonstrated superior predictive performance. The post Nomogram Predicts Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Cryoballoon Ablation appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Cancer charities back early detection with $12m push
item.description: The programme will focus on pancreatic, ovarian and oesophageal cancers – three indications that often spread silently. The post Cancer charities back early detection with $12m push appeared first on European Medical Journal.
